facts.fact: MTN MoMo Zambia introduced direct wallet-to-bank transfers in January 2026, the first Zambian mobile money provider to let customers send funds to international bank accounts in the EU, UK and Canada, per ITWeb Africa.

ZMB.note: No government payments to people stated.
Only an operator user count, no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: MTN MoMo has more than five million users in Zambia, according to the operator, and MoMo customers can pay at FNB point-of-sale terminals.
An existing MTN MoMo and FNB partnership already lets customers transfer funds between MoMo wallets and FNB accounts, and the two launched MoMo cash-out at FNB ATMs without a card or FNB account.

ZMB.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
